newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India issues tender to sell 25,000/T Oct naphtha.
newsitem.headline: India issues tender to sell 25,000/T Oct naphtha.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has issued a tender to sell 25,000 tonnes of high aromatics naphtha (HAN) for loading on October 17-19 , traders said on Monday.
The tender closes on October 2 and offers should be valid until October 4.
In its last tender, IOC sold 50,000 tonnes of HAN ex-Madras for lifting in early October to a Swiss trader at $19.00 per tonne below North West European (NWE) spot quotes on a free-on-board basis.
Its last ex-Bombay HAN cargo was sold at $25.84 below NWE quotes for a September 27-29 lifting.
